ProphecySummary: Paul says all will stand before the judgment seat of Christ, and everyone will give account of himself to God; in 2 Corinthians he restates it as all appearing before that seat to receive according to what was done in the body.
Fulfillment: Awaited. No such universal accounting before Christ has yet taken place; the 2 Corinthians passage is a restatement of the same prediction, not a separate one.
